The bug has been fixed and verified against the requirements.

### Cause of the Bug
In [`DSCompiler.atan2`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/analysis/differentiation/DSCompiler.java#L1382-L1421), special IEEE 754 edge cases such as `atan2(±0.0, ±0.0)` resulted in `0.0 / 0.0 = NaN` during calculation. The special cases handling at the end of the computation was incomplete and omitted setting the result value using [`FastMath.atan2(y[yOffset], x[xOffset])`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/util/FastMath.java#L2579).

### Fix Applied
Assigned `result[resultOffset] = FastMath.atan2(y[yOffset], x[xOffset]);` at the end of [`DSCompiler.atan2`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/analysis/differentiation/DSCompiler.java#L1419) to correctly handle special edge cases.

The patch was saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch) and all Cucumber scenarios pass completely.
